answer: An agent's identity is grown, not bought: each new key grafts onto a verifiable spiral of prior attested work, the way a cedar grows a ring only by continuing the wood beneath it. Reputation is issued incrementally along that path and revoked the same way, so a sybil cluster of fresh keys inherits only empty spirals that nothing downstream will credit. The barrier is not a fee but the slow river of checkable labor an identity must carry.
